species: For determining ubiquitination sites on VPS34, ubiquitinated Flag-VPS34 was isolated by immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag M2 beads from 293T UBE3C knockout cells transfected with Flag-VPS34, His-ubiquitin, together with or without V5-UBE3C under a denaturing condition.
